import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp")
from harness import *

def one(raw, **kw):
    return run(batch([job(raw=raw, **kw)]))[0]

# ---------------- local ingress ----------------
L = {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}
check("local basic", one(req(), ingress=L)["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("local alias from", one(req(frm="sip:e1@alias.studio.test;tag=t"), ingress=L)["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("local tel alias from", one(req(frm="tel:+12025550122;tag=t"), ingress=L)["identity"], "sip:desk@sales.test")
check("local unknown subject", run(batch([job(raw=req(), ingress={"kind":"local","subject":"nope"})])), [rej("unauthenticated")])
check("local unknown from", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:x@studio.test;tag=t"), ingress=L)])), [rej("identity")])
check("local unallowed from", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:desk@sales.test;tag=t"), ingress=L,
    )], accounts={"session-k": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": []}})), [rej("identity")])
check("local unhosted from", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:desk@sales.test;tag=t"), ingress=L,
    )], gateways={"edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {}}})), [rej("identity")])
check("local ppi selected", one(req(extra=("P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>",)), ingress=L)["identity"], "sip:desk@sales.test")
check("local ppi unknown", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:x@y.test>",)), ingress=L)])), [rej("identity")])
check("local ppi unhosted", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>",)), ingress=L,
    )], gateways={"edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {}}})), [rej("identity")])
check("local ppi tel alias", one(req(extra=("P-Preferred-Identity: <tel:+12025550122>",)), ingress=L)["identity"], "sip:desk@sales.test")
check("local from unknown w/ ppi ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:x@y.test;tag=t", extra=("P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>",)), ingress=L)])), [rej("identity")])
check("local anon from -> primary", one(req(frm="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=t"), ingress=L)["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("local anon from unhosted primary", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=t"), ingress=L,
    )], gateways={"edge": {"local_domains": ["sales.test"], "peers": {}}})), [rej("identity")])
check("local anon from + ppi", one(req(frm="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=t",
    extra=("P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>",)), ingress=L)["identity"], "sip:desk@sales.test")
check("local rpid ignored", one(req(extra=("Remote-Party-ID: <sip:unknown@nowhere.test>",)), ingress=L)["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("local pai ignored", one(req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>, <tel:+12025550121>",)), ingress=L)["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("local rpid 2 addrs syntax", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("Remote-Party-ID: <sip:a@b.c>, <tel:+1>",)), ingress=L)])), [rej("syntax")])
check("local ppi 2 addrs syntax", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <tel:+12025550121>",)), ingress=L)])), [rej("syntax")])

# ---------------- PAI grammar ----------------
P = {"kind": "peer", "name": "edge"}
check("pai two same scheme", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <sip:desk@sales.test>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("syntax"))
check("pai three", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <tel:+12025550121>, <tel:+12025550122>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("syntax"))
check("pai empty member", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>,",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("syntax"))
check("pai empty value", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity:",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("syntax"))
check("pai two lines concat", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>", "P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550121>")), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("pai comma in quotes ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=('P-Asserted-Identity: "a,b" <sip:ember@studio.test>',)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("pai comma in brackets ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test,x>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("identity"))
check("pai display ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: Bob <sip:ember@studio.test>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")

# ---------------- peer ingress ----------------
check("peer basic", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test;tag=t",
    extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["basis"], "peer")
check("peer unknown name", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",)),
    ingress={"kind":"peer","name":"ghost"}, gw="inside")])), [rej("unauthenticated")])
check("peer no pai", run(batch([job(raw=req(), ingress=P, gw="inside")])), [rej("unauthenticated")])
check("peer pai unknown", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:x@y.test>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("identity"))
check("peer pai disagreement", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>, <tel:+12025550122>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("identity"))
check("peer pai no authority", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",)), ingress=P, gw="narrow")]))[0], rej("identity"))
check("peer authority includes hosted", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",)),
    ingress={"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}, gw="edge2")], gateways={
        "edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test"], "peers": {}},
        "edge2": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {"edge": ["studio.test"]}},
    }))["results"][0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("peer from mismatch", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:desk@sales.test;tag=t", extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("identity"))
check("peer from unknown", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:zz@yy.test;tag=t", extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("identity"))
check("peer anon from ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=t", extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",)), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("peer ppi must match", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>", "P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>")), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("identity"))
check("peer rpid must match", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>", "Remote-Party-ID: <sip:desk@sales.test>")), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0], rej("identity"))
check("peer rpid alias match ok", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>", "Remote-Party-ID: <tel:+12025550121>")), ingress=P, gw="inside")]))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")
check("peer empty auth list", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",)),
    ingress={"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}, gw="g2")], gateways={
        "edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {}},
        "g2": {"local_domains": [], "peers": {"edge": []}},
    }))[0], rej("identity"))

# ---------------- untrusted ----------------
check("untrusted", run(batch([job(raw=req(), ingress={"kind":"untrusted"})])), [rej("unauthenticated")])
check("untrusted syntax first", run(batch([job(raw=req(cl="4"), ingress={"kind":"untrusted"})])), [rej("syntax")])
check("untrusted anon", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"), ingress={"kind":"untrusted"})])), [rej("unauthenticated")])

summary()
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/tests4.py
